review_layout: One row per sky in brief order; nearest-neighbour source input on the left at native master size, unscaled selected HD master on the right.
resolution_note: Requested the largest native square output, preferably 2048 × 2048. The built-in tool returned 1254 × 1254 for every attempt; selected masters retain that native resolution and meet the minimum 1024 × 1024 requirement.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: 6plansky1, a seamless tileable hand-painted Might and Magic sky texture HD restoration.
Input image 1 is the edit target and the exact composition/palette reference. Repaint THIS SAME IMAGE at the largest native square resolution available, preferably 2048 x 2048, minimum 1024 x 1024.
Preserve the exact composition at identical normalized coordinates: every cloud's position, size, silhouette, direction of flow, softness and relative brightness; every gap's shape and size. Preserve the original palette, light direction, coverage and mood. Do not rotate, shift, crop, zoom, enlarge, rearrange, add or remove any clouds. Keep the sparse wisps where sparse and the thick painted regions where thick.
Change only fidelity: replace 8-bit dithering, palette steps and pixel blocks with smooth painted gradients INSIDE clouds, soft delicate wisps, fine billows and restrained subtle internal shading. Faithful hand-painted game art, not a photograph, not a newly invented sky. Do not inflate wisps into big rounded cumulus heaps or intensify contrast.
Palette, brightest first: #c8b98e, #9e928d, #706e8d, #4d5a8e, #30498c.
Every genuinely open gap between clouds must be filled with ONE perfectly flat, spatially uniform opaque RGB colour #30498c, including the large gaps and the tiny gaps. No gradient, noise, haze, grain, mottling or texture in the open sky. Feathered cloud edges transition naturally into that exact solid colour. Do not turn faint existing clouds into blank sky.
Critical seamless tiling: treat the square as a torus. Clouds crossing the left edge continue at the matching vertical position on the right edge; clouds crossing the top continue at the matching horizontal position on the bottom. Exact opposing-edge continuity in cloud shapes, colour and soft shading. Preserve the original edge-crossing formations. A 2 x 2 repetition of this square must show no seams or cut-off formations. Output ONE square tile, not a tiled preview.
The picture fills the canvas edge to edge, opaque PNG, with no margins, borders or framing. Do not add sun, moon, stars, rays, lens flare, horizon, ground, mountains, birds, buildings, text, logos, frames, vignettes or watermarks.
attempts.reason: Rejected: cloud highlights are brighter and yellower than the source palette; targeted colour correction requested. Layout, minimum resolution and gap colour checks passed; no visible tile seam.
